cards.title: Re-entry: south flow
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Beach Line Departures/Shamrock Re-entry
cards.leadIn: Follow the beach line departure procedures. Once cleared by Approach:
instructions: Descend to 1,000' MSL and join the Southern Arrival
Cleared at or before the High Bridge: climb and maintain 1,000' MSL instead of 2,500'
Cleared after passing the High Bridge: climb or descend to 1,000' MSL, parallel the beach line at 1 WTD, accelerate to 240 KIAS
cards.source: Binder, p. 17; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 62–65.
